name: Law offices, jobs and pay by county, with solo-practice counts: BLS QCEW, Census CBP and Nonemployer Statistics
description: Private offices of lawyers (NAICS 541110) in every U.S. county, every state and the nation. For each area: establishments, March employment and average weekly pay from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (the latest quarter, with the seven before it); employer offices from the Census Bureau's County Business Patterns 2023 exactly as first published; firms with no employees in legal services from Nonemployer Statistics 2024; and the 2025 Census population estimate, so each area has offices and solo firms per 10,000 residents. Employment and pay are given exactly as BLS publishes them for each area, never estimated. An office is an establishment, not a lawyer.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Law offices, jobs and pay by county, with solo-practice counts: BLS QCEW, Census CBP and Nonemployer Statistics (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963687

distribution.name: law-offices.csv

distribution.name: law-offices.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: law-offices-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in law-offices-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to law-offices.csv on id.

recordSet.name: law-offices

field.name: area
field.description: County FIPS code (5 digits), state FIPS code (2 digits) or US

field.name: areaName
field.description: County, state or nation name; counties end with the state abbreviation

field.name: areaType
field.description: county, state or us

field.name: state
field.description: Two-letter state code

field.name: period

field.name: qcew_estabs
field.description: BLS QCEW private establishments in NAICS 541110 (offices of lawyers) in the quarter

field.name: cbp_offices

field.name: cbp_employees
field.description: CBP 2023 employment (the Census adds noise to protect confidentiality)

field.name: population
field.description: Census population estimate for July 1, 2025

field.name: estabs_per_10k
field.description: qcew_estabs per 10,000 residents

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The machine value (see unit)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: confidence
